#+TITLE: Edge Cases for Org to Markdown Preview Conversion

* 1. Edge Cases

#+NAME: Full emphasis set and sub-superscripts
#+BEGIN_FIXTURE
*bold*, /italic/, _underline_, +strike+, ~code~, =verbatim=, H_2O and x^{2}.
#+END_FIXTURE

#+EXPECTED: :type markdown
<strong>bold</strong>, <em>italic</em>, <u>underline</u>, <s>strike</s>, <code>code</code>, <code class="org-verbatim">verbatim</code>, H<sub>2</sub>O and x<sup>2</sup>.

#+NAME: Inactive timestamps ranges escapes and macros
#+BEGIN_FIXTURE
Inactive [2024-02-02] and range <2024-01-01>--<2024-01-07>, escaped \*star\*, macro {{{hello(world)}}}.
#+END_FIXTURE

#+EXPECTED: :type markdown
Inactive <span class="org-timestamp org-timestamp-inactive">[2024-02-02]</span> and range <span class="org-timestamp"><2024-01-01>--<2024-01-07></span>, escaped \*star\*, macro {{{hello(world)}}}.

#+NAME: Deep headline levels are clamped to six
#+BEGIN_FIXTURE
,******* Deep headline
#+END_FIXTURE

#+EXPECTED: :type markdown
###### Deep headline

#+NAME: Customized block keeps content
#+BEGIN_FIXTURE
#+BEGIN_MYBLOCK
raw content
#+END_MYBLOCK
#+END_FIXTURE

#+EXPECTED: :type markdown
```myblock
raw content
```

#+NAME: Center block
#+BEGIN_FIXTURE
#+BEGIN_CENTER
Centered text
#+END_CENTER
#+END_FIXTURE

#+EXPECTED: :type markdown
<div class="org-center">
Centered text
</div>

#+NAME: Verse block preserves line breaks
#+BEGIN_FIXTURE
#+BEGIN_VERSE
line one
line two
#+END_VERSE
#+END_FIXTURE

#+EXPECTED: :type markdown
<pre class="org-verse">
line one
line two
</pre>

#+NAME: Ordered list and description item
#+BEGIN_FIXTURE
1. first item
2. term :: description here
#+END_FIXTURE

#+EXPECTED: :type markdown
1. first item
1. **term**: description here

#+NAME: Multi-line paragraph wraps softly
#+BEGIN_FIXTURE
This is line one.
This is line two.
#+END_FIXTURE

#+EXPECTED: :type markdown
This is line one.
This is line two.

#+NAME: Angle links pass through
#+BEGIN_FIXTURE
See <https://example.org/x> for details.
#+END_FIXTURE

#+EXPECTED: :type markdown
See <https://example.org/x> for details.
